summary: Phantasmagoria entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Phantasmagoria
entries.definitive_edition: Current GOG or Steam release, with original CD-ROM route documented if artifact preservation matters

emulation.notes: Use storefront wrapper for primary, original hardware or manual DOSBox only for comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Modern PC capture of original FMV assets

primary.why: Phantasmagoria is a Sierra FMV adventure with modern PC storefront releases that package the classic game for contemporary systems. The GOG/Steam route is the practical capture path, while original CD-ROM media is useful for artifact preservation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current GOG or Steam release. Record storefront, DOSBox/wrapper version, aspect/display scaling, censor/content settings if any, chapter progress, puzzle hints/walkthrough use, and whether original CD-ROM media was compared.

secondary.exclusive_content: Original seven-disc artifact and installer context
secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving original media handling and packaging.
secondary.why: Modern storefront releases are easier to capture, but the original CD set is historically important.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record display scaling and wrapper settings; do not merge with Phantasmagoria: A Puzzle of Flesh.
